notes: The north-pole pentagon is intentionally unpopulated: 30 square panels plus 11 pentagon-centre panels.
Northern centre panels present their top edge toward the pole; southern centre panels present their bottom edge toward the pole.
Logical effect indices run from global north to south; deployment physical indices follow the saved output route and WLED bus ranges.
The measured panel contract uses front-view pixel 0/DIN at top-left, straight left-to-right rows progressing downward, pixel 63/DOUT at bottom-right, and WLED GRB order 0.
The saved output route and GPIOs are the assumed prototype assembly contract; they are authored but not measured.
Physical indices follow the displayed output routes.

Within-panel physical order follows the panel profile: Measured row-major order: front view starts at DIN/pixel 0 at top-left, each row runs left-to-right, rows progress downward, and pixel 63/DOUT is bottom-right. In the stored back view this is top-right to bottom-left with every row right-to-left.

wledColorOrder.note: One fused physical panel test on 2026-08-25 showed RGB order 1 swaps red and green; WLED GRB order 0 displays red, green, and blue correctly.

readinessBlockers: Electrical protection approval is separate from mapping readiness.

assumptions.note: The measured panel order comes from the numbered one-panel bench test; route, GPIO, and installed turns remain authored assumptions.

notes: Panel route order is authored and persists exactly as saved.
DIN is top-right and DOUT is bottom-left in the measured back-view panel convention.
The connector marker inset remains schematic until exact pad centres are measured.
GPIO numbers are assigned but not measured. Installed panel orientation and within-panel pixel order remain provisional.
